blocks.text: CAGAYAN DE ORO CITY — The success of a legislative push to pass a genuine anti-political dynasty law “rests heavily on the mobilization of the youth and citizen action,” former Supreme Court (SC) Associate Justice Antonio Carpio said here on Wednesday, October 14. Carpio spoke at the Archdiocesan organizational meeting of the “Dapat Isa Lang” (D1L) campaign held at the Patrick Cronin Hall inside the San Agustin Metropolitan Cathedral Compound. The former SC magistrate pointed out that relying on politicians to dismantle dynasties is a dead end. “When you ask a group of students how many of them are planning to […]...
